physical_subject: Why are equal dice not equal totals?
relationship: Independent uniform dice have triangular sum counts; copied identical results retain uniform marginals but only even sums.
operation: A36cell joint grid collects diagonal sum events and then collapses to copied-result diagonal dependence.
closest_prior: Earlier nontransitive dice and image convolution
substantive_difference: Probability convolution for sums and explicit same-marginal dependence counterexample, not dice tournaments or edge filtering.
